facts.text: Marketing said that this year, fashion trends in clothes, shoes, and furniture were inspired by fruits and vegetables.
facts.source_quote: Wha what we really see this year is that uh everything from clothes to shoes and furniture is is inspired by fruits and vegetables ,

facts.text: Marketing recommended taking this fruit-and-vegetable fashion trend into account when designing the product.
facts.source_quote: so I think we really have to take this into account for the design of the the thing .

facts.text: Marketing ranked design priorities: fancy look and feel is the most important (importance 6 of 7), being technologically innovative is next (importance 3), and being easy to use is comparatively the least important of the three.
facts.source_quote: 'Cause it's it's really what people want . Even if it's in general fashion , we want it to be in the remote control . And then uh if if we take the ordering or the ranking of all the points , fancy look and feel has , on a score of seven would have six as importance . Uh the remote control has to be technologically innovative , it's three . Then easy to use uh it's not so important actually with respect to other y other ones .

facts.text: Marketing also mentioned that people wanted a spongy touch.
facts.source_quote: And the other point I haven't mention is people wan want to have a spongy touch ,

facts.text: Marketing noted the spongy-touch trend might not fit well with a wooden design.
facts.source_quote: okay so this is this maybe doesn't really fit with the wooden design .

facts.text: Marketing suggested the spongy material could be plastic-like or, more likely, rubber-like.
facts.source_quote: plastic-like , but rubber , mayb maybe , you know , rubber-like uh

facts.text: The Project Manager proposed the case be something spongy rather than wood.
facts.source_quote: So you think {gap} case . Something spongy . {vocalsound} Someth no wood .

facts.text: Marketing clarified that avoiding wood should mean avoiding it only on the part that is touched, not excluding wood altogether.
facts.source_quote: Maybe not no wood , but I mean ma maybe not the part you touching you know .

facts.text: The Industrial Designer suggested wood could be used for the bottom of the case, depending on the design.
facts.source_quote: I think we can have wood for example in the bottom and , you know . It depends on the design we want ,

facts.text: The group described wood's feel as natural.
Marketing noted that using wood doesn't align well with the desired spongy feel.
facts.source_quote: Yeah , I mean it's not exactly right for the spongy point of view .

facts.text: Marketing proposed combining materials: part wood, with some rubber for the buttons.
facts.source_quote: But we could maybe have both like part of wood and some rubber for the buttons ,

relations.text: Combining the importance ranking (fancy look and feel highest) with the Paris/Milan fashion trend is what led Marketing to point toward a fruit-and-vegetable theme.
relations.source_quote: we go to the fruits and vede vegetables .

relations.text: The tension between wanting a spongy feel and wanting to use wood is resolved by proposing a mixed-material design using both wood and rubber for the buttons.
